extracted.name: Snowball cookies
ingredient_lines: 1 cup powdered sugar plus extra for coating
instruction_lines: Heat oven to 350 degrees and spread out pecans on a rimmed baking sheet and bake for 8 minutes then let cool
Beat butter and sugar together till creamy then mix in vanilla, almond and salt
Gradually mix in flour and then mix in pecans till well combined
Shape dough into 1 tablespoonfuls and roll into a ball place on a parchment lined baking sheet and refrigerate for 30 minutes
Let cool slightly then roll in powdered sugar and place on a baking sheet to finish cooling then store in a covered container
